Baidu Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

Nov 16, 2026
Download    Print

PDF Version

BEIJING, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Baidu, Inc. (NASDAQ: BIDU and HKEX: 9888 (HKD Counter) and 89888 (RMB Counter)), ("Baidu" or the "Company"), a leading AI company with strong Internet foundation, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

"Our long-term investments in full-stack AI are translating into meaningful growth at scale. This quarter, AI Cloud Infra emerged as a major driver of Baidu General Business revenue expansion, and Baidu Core AI-powered Business[1] accounted for 53% of Baidu General Business revenue, further reinforcing AI's position at the core of our business. We also continued to expand use cases, strengthen capabilities, and improve user experience across our AI applications portfolio," said Robin Li, Co-founder and CEO of Baidu. "We are pleased to see our AI-first strategy yielding tangible results even as we navigate headwinds in online marketing. AI is playing an increasingly important role in shaping Baidu's future, and we remain committed to investing decisively to capture long-term growth opportunities and solidify our competitive edge."

"In Q3, Baidu General Business revenue returned to year-over-year growth, increasing by 1%. AI Cloud Infra revenue[1] grew 94% year over year, helping to partially offset weakness in online marketing and supporting the overall top-line recovery. AI Cloud Infra is becoming a new growth engine for Baidu, with an increasing contribution to both revenue and profit. Operating cash flow for Baidu also remained positive in the third quarter, reaching RMB 2.8 billion, underscoring our solid cash generation and financial health," said Haijian He, CFO of Baidu. "We will maintain a disciplined approach to capital allocation with a clear focus on investment returns as we continue to invest in AI. "

Operational Highlights[1]

Corporate

  • In September 2026, Baidu's autonomous ride-hailing service, Apollo Go, was selected as a "Representative Case of Sustainable Overseas Operations by Chinese Enterprises in 2026" by the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and the Listed Companies Association of China, recognizing its green, safe, and intelligent autonomous ride-hailing services.
  • Baidu has returned US$373 million to shareholders since the beginning of Q1 2026 through repurchases of its shares under the current share repurchase program.
  • In November 2026, Baidu unveiled ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, the latest foundation model in its ERNIE family. The model delivers strong coding and agentic capabilities, supporting complex workflows and producing usable, high-quality outputs across knowledge work, video creation, game development and 3D modeling. On the latest Code Arena WebDev leaderboard, it ranks second among open-source models globally.
  • At Baidu World 2026 in November, Baidu introduced Token Exchange, a neutral, transparent and trusted marketplace connecting AI model service providers with customers.
  • In February 2026, Baidu announced the adoption, for the first time, of a dividend policy for its ordinary shares. The Company expects to declare the first payment of dividend before the end of 2026, subject to Board approval and prevailing market conditions.

Baidu Core AI-powered Business

AI Cloud Infra

  • Revenue from AI Cloud Infra was RMB 8.2 billion in the third quarter of 2026, up 94% year over year. Within AI Cloud Infra, revenue from GPU Cloud[2] increased by 191% year over year and 43% quarter over quarter in the third quarter of 2026.
  • In the third quarter of 2026, AI Cloud Infra continued to experience strong demand, with a more diversified customer base, increased customer prepayments, and a continued shift toward longer-term contracts.
  • Revenue from external customers' token usage on Baidu's Qianfan MaaS platform increased by 1,159% year over year in the third quarter of 2026.
  • In July 2026, Kunlunxin M100 was publicly displayed for the first time during the World Artificial Intelligence Conference. Optimized for large-scale AI inference, M100 is expected to be ready for volume production by the end of 2026.

AI Applications

  • Revenue from AI Applications was RMB 2.6 billion in the third quarter of 2026, approximately flat year over year.
  • In the third quarter of 2026, Baidu continued to enhance DuMate, its general work agent, by integrating capabilities from its internal workplace AI agent dodo, AI coding assistant Comate, and vibe coding platform Miaoda to support a broader range of tasks through a single agent.
  • In September 2026, AI DAU penetration across Baidu Wenku and Baidu Drive increased by 60.7% year over year, reflecting broader adoption of their AI-powered features.
  • In November 2026, Baidu launched Famou Agent 3.0, its self-evolving agent designed to help enterprises solve complex operational problems, at Baidu World 2026.
  • In the third quarter of 2026, production costs for Baidu Yijing hyper-realistic digital humans decreased by approximately 80% compared with the fourth quarter of 2025.

Robotaxi

  • Apollo Go continued to make meaningful progress across key markets. In Shenzhen, now one of Apollo Go's largest markets, fully driverless operational rides increased by approximately 170% quarter over quarter. In Dubai, Apollo Go expanded its fully driverless commercial operations, broadening its operating area and doubling its fleet size. In London, Apollo Go continued open-road testing in partnership with Uber and Lyft, progressively expanding its testing areas. In Hong Kong, Apollo Go continued fully driverless testing on Airport Island.
  • As of October 2026, Apollo Go's global footprint has reached 30 cities. In the third quarter of 2026, Apollo Go fleets accumulated approximately 34 million autonomous kilometers. As of October 31, 2026, Apollo Go fleet has accumulated more than 390 million autonomous kilometers, while maintaining an outstanding safety record.
  • In October 2026, Apollo Go received the Consumer Service Award at the Self-Driving Industry Awards (SDIA) in the UK, recognizing its global operating experience and track record of delivering fully driverless rides at a world-leading scale.

AI-native Marketing Services

  • Revenue from AI-native marketing services was RMB 2.4 billion in the third quarter of 2026, down 15% year over year. The decline was primarily due to a challenging macroeconomic environment, evolving competitive dynamics, and our strategic decision to prioritize user experience over near-term monetization at this stage of our AI Search transformation.
  • Baidu App's MAUs reached 604 million in September 2026.

Revenue was RMB30.8 billion ($4.60 billion), decreasing 1% year over year and 2% quarter over quarter. Revenue from Baidu General Business was RMB25.0 billion ($3.73 billion), increasing 1% year over year and decreasing 1% quarter over quarter. Revenue from iQIYI was RMB6.0 billion ($896 million), decreasing 10% year over year and 4% quarter over quarter.

Cost of revenue was RMB19.9 billion ($2.97 billion), increasing 9% year over year and 4% quarter over quarter. The year over year increase was primarily due to increases in costs related to cloud business and traffic acquisition costs, partially offset by a decrease in content costs.

Selling, general and administrative expenses were RMB5.5 billion ($815 million), decreasing 17% year over year, primarily due to decreases in expected credit loss expenses and channel spending expenses, and increasing 19% quarter over quarter, primarily due to an increase in expected credit loss expenses.

Research and development expenses were RMB4.8 billion ($720 million), decreasing 7% year over year and increasing 5% quarter over quarter.

Operating income was RMB626 million ($93 million) and operating margin was 2%. Non-GAAP operating income was RMB1.7 billion ($255 million) and non-GAAP operating margin was 6%.

Total other income, net was RMB1.2 billion ($175 million), compared to RMB1.9 billion for the same period last year and RMB184 million last quarter. The year over year decrease was primarily due to decreases in pickup of earnings from equity method investments and fair value gain from long-term investments, and an increase in net foreign exchange loss arising from exchange rate fluctuation between Renminbi and U.S. dollar, partially offset by a shift from fair value loss to fair value gain on exchangeable bonds. The quarter over quarter increase was primarily due to a shift from fair value loss to fair value gain on trading debt investments.

Income tax expense was RMB427 million ($64 million), compared to income tax benefit of RMB1.8 billion for the same period last year and income tax expense of RMB1.0 billion last quarter.

Net income attributable to Baidu was RMB1.4 billion ($208 million), net margin for Baidu was 5% and diluted earnings per ADS was RMB4.35 ($0.65). Non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu was RMB2.4 billion ($357 million), non-GAAP net margin for Baidu was 8% and non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS was RMB6.78 ($1.01).

Adjusted EBITDA was RMB4.5 billion ($670 million) and adjusted EBITDA margin was 15%.

We define total cash and investments as cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, short-term investments, net, long-term time deposits and held-to-maturity investments, and adjusted long-term investments. As of September 30, 2026, total cash and investments were RMB276.6 billion ($41.25 billion). Operating cash flow was RMB2.8 billion ($414 million).

For detailed financial information of Baidu General Business and iQIYI, please see the appended financial tables.

About Baidu

Founded in 2000, Baidu's mission is to make the complicated world simpler through technology. Baidu is a leading AI company with strong Internet foundation, trading on NASDAQ under "BIDU" and HKEX under "9888". One Baidu ADS represents eight Class A ordinary shares.

Non-GAAP Financial Measures

To supplement Baidu's consolidated financial results presented in accordance with GAAP, Baidu uses the following non-GAAP financial measures: non-GAAP operating income, non-GAAP operating margin, non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu, non-GAAP net margin, non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EBITDA margin, adjusted long-term investments and free cash flow. The presentation of these non-GAAP financial measures is not intended to be considered in isolation or as a substitute for the financial information prepared and presented in accordance with GAAP.

Baidu believes that these non-GAAP financial measures provide meaningful supplemental information regarding its performance and liquidity by excluding certain items that may not be indicative of its recurring core business operating results, such as operating performance excluding non-cash charges or non-operating in nature. The Company believes that both management and investors benefit from referring to these non-GAAP financial measures in assessing its performance and when planning and forecasting future periods. These non-GAAP financial measures also facilitate management's internal comparisons to Baidu's historical performance and liquidity. The Company believes these non-GAAP financial measures are useful to investors in allowing for greater transparency with respect to supplemental information used by management in its financial and operational decision making. A limitation of using these non-GAAP financial measures is that these non-GAAP measures exclude certain items that have been and will continue to be for the foreseeable future a significant component in the Company's results of operations. These non-GAAP financial measures presented here may not be comparable to similarly titled measures presented by other companies. Other companies may calculate similarly titled measures differently, limiting their usefulness as comparative measures to the Company's data.

Non-GAAP operating income represents operating income excluding share-based compensation expenses, amortization and impairment of intangible assets resulting from business combinations, and impairment of long-lived assets.

Non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu represents net income attributable to Baidu excluding share-based compensation expenses, amortization and impairment of intangible assets resulting from business combinations, impairment of long-lived assets, disposal gain or loss, impairment of long-term investments, and fair value gain or loss of long-term investments and exchangeable bonds, adjusted for related income tax effects. Baidu's share of equity method investments for these non-GAAP reconciling items, amortization and impairment of intangible assets not on the investees' books, accretion of their redeemable non-controlling interests, the gain or loss associated with the issuance of shares by the investees at a price higher or lower than the carrying value per share, and penalty imposed by administrative authorities, adjusted for related income tax effects, are also excluded.

Non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS represents diluted earnings per ADS calculated by dividing non-GAAP net income attributable to Baidu, by the weighted average number of ordinary shares expressed in ADS. Adjusted EBITDA represents non-GAAP operating income excluding depreciation of fixed assets, and amortization of finance lease right-of-use assets and intangible assets excluding those resulting from business combinations. Adjusted long-term investments represent long-term investments, net, with publicly listed equity method investments adjusted to fair value based on quoted market prices.

For more information on non-GAAP financial measures, please see the tables captioned "Reconciliations of non-GAAP financial measures to the nearest comparable GAAP measure."
